import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 1, "n_envs": 256, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 64, "lr": 0.001, "ent_coef": 0.005, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

trials.hypothesis: Same recipe as C1. The network is wider, and for each brick type the head adds a convolution whose kernel is that brick's footprint, alongside max and min pools. Each anchor then sees every footprint cell's features, so it can check that all columns sit at the same height and that the landing cells are missing in the target, instead of seeing only pooled summaries. The network costs about 1.3 times the starting one. If it does not beat C1 by more than seed noise, this head is not the bottleneck.

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 1, "n_envs": 256, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 64, "lr": 0.001, "ent_coef": 0.005, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

STEM = 64
WIDTH = 48
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class FootHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.convs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(proj, hid, (dy, dx)) for dy, dx in self.fps])
        self.mm = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(2 * proj, hid, 1, bias=False) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), conv, mm, out in zip(self.fps, self.convs, self.mm, self.outs):
            q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
            a = conv(q)
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn = p, p
            else:
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(a + mm(torch.cat([mx, mn], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, WIDTH, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = FootHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(s + self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 1, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "lr": 0.001, "ent_coef": 0.005, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

WIDTH = 16
PROJ = 12
HID = 12


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Z = int(spec.Z)
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        W = WIDTH
        self.inp = nn.Conv2d(16, W, 1)
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 1)
        self.col = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 1)
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(W, PROJ, 1)
        self.convs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(PROJ, HID, (dy, dx)) for dy, dx in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HID, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * W, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        Z = self.Z
        lay = obs[:, :4 * Z].reshape(B, 4, Z, Y, X)
        pad = F.pad(lay, (0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 1))
        stk = torch.cat([pad[:, :, 0:Z], pad[:, :, 1:Z + 1], pad[:, :, 2:Z + 2]], dim=1)
        g = obs[:, 4 * Z:4 * Z + 3].unsqueeze(2).expand(B, 3, Z, Y, X)
        zc = (torch.arange(Z, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype) / max(Z - 1, 1)).view(1, 1, Z, 1, 1).expand(B, 1, Z, Y, X)
        x = torch.cat([stk, g, zc], dim=1).permute(0, 2, 1, 3, 4).reshape(B * Z, 16, Y, X)
        h = F.relu(self.inp(x))
        h = F.relu(self.c1(h))
        W = h.shape[1]
        colf = self.col(h.view(B, Z, W, Y, X).amax(1))
        colb = colf.unsqueeze(1).expand(B, Z, W, Y, X).reshape(B * Z, W, Y, X)
        h = F.relu(h + self.c2(h) + colb)
        p = self.proj(h)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), conv, out in zip(self.fps, self.convs, self.outs):
            q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
            a = F.relu(conv(q))
            o = out(a).view(B, Z, Y, X)
            res.append(torch.logsumexp(o, dim=1))
        place = torch.stack(res, dim=1).flatten(1)
        h5 = h.view(B, Z, W, Y, X)
        gf = torch.cat([h5.mean(dim=(1, 3, 4)), h5.amax(dim=(1, 3, 4))], dim=1)
        gg = self.glob(gf)
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(gg)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(gg).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 1, "n_envs": 256, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 64, "lr": 0.001, "ent_coef": 0.005, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32
DP = 16
DH = 256


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        Y, X = int(spec.Y), int(spec.X)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.dproj = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, DP, 1)
        self.dense = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(DP * Y * X, DH), nn.ReLU(), nn.Linear(DH, spec.n_actions))
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH + DH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        dh = self.dense[1](self.dense[0](F.relu(self.dproj(f)).flatten(1)))
        dl = self.dense[2](dh)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3)), dh], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1) + dl
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import math
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 1, "n_envs": 256, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 64, "lr": 0.0007, "ent_coef": 0.005, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

D = 32
NH = 4
FF = 64
NL = 2
AH = 32


class Block(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.n1 = nn.LayerNorm(D)
        self.qkv = nn.Linear(D, 3 * D)
        self.o = nn.Linear(D, D)
        self.n2 = nn.LayerNorm(D)
        self.f1 = nn.Linear(D, FF)
        self.f2 = nn.Linear(FF, D)

    def forward(self, h):
        B, N, _ = h.shape
        dh = D // NH
        q, k, v = self.qkv(self.n1(h)).chunk(3, dim=2)
        q = q.reshape(B, N, NH, dh).transpose(1, 2)
        k = k.reshape(B, N, NH, dh).transpose(1, 2)
        v = v.reshape(B, N, NH, dh).transpose(1, 2)
        a = torch.softmax(torch.matmul(q, k.transpose(2, 3)) / math.sqrt(dh), dim=-1)
        o = torch.matmul(a, v).transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, N, D)
        h = h + self.o(o)
        h = h + self.f2(F.relu(self.f1(self.n2(h))))
        return h


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        N = int(spec.Y) * int(spec.X)
        self.n_place = int(spec.n_place)
        self.embed = nn.Linear(spec.in_channels, D)
        self.pos = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, N, D) * 0.02)
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([Block() for _ in range(NL)])
        self.nf = nn.LayerNorm(D)
        self.aq = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(self.n_place, D) * 0.02)
        self.qp = nn.Linear(D, D)
        self.kp = nn.Linear(D, D)
        self.vp = nn.Linear(D, D)
        self.a1 = nn.Linear(D, AH)
        self.a2 = nn.Linear(AH, 1)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * D, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        t = obs.permute(0, 2, 3, 1).reshape(B, Y * X, C)
        h = self.embed(t) + self.pos
        for blk in self.blocks:
            h = blk(h)
        h = self.nf(h)
        N = h.shape[1]
        A = self.n_place
        dh = D // NH
        q = self.qp(self.aq).reshape(A, NH, dh).transpose(0, 1).unsqueeze(0)
        k = self.kp(h).reshape(B, N, NH, dh).transpose(1, 2)
        v = self.vp(h).reshape(B, N, NH, dh).transpose(1, 2)
        att = torch.softmax(torch.matmul(q, k.transpose(2, 3)) / math.sqrt(dh), dim=-1)
        o = torch.matmul(att, v).transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, A, D)
        place = self.a2(F.relu(self.a1(o + self.aq.unsqueeze(0)))).squeeze(2)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([h.mean(1), h.amax(1)], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 1, "n_envs": 256, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 64, "lr": 0.0007, "ent_coef": 0.005, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

CELL_H = 32
CELL_O = 12
HID = 512


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        Y, X = int(spec.Y), int(spec.X)
        self.cell = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, CELL_H, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(CELL_H, CELL_O, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.mlp = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(CELL_O * Y * X, HID), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(HID, HID), nn.ReLU())
        self.pi = nn.Linear(HID, spec.n_actions)
        self.v = nn.Linear(HID, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        c = self.cell(obs).flatten(1)
        h = self.mlp(c)
        return self.pi(h), self.v(h).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.T = int(spec.n_types)
        self.n_place = int(spec.n_place)
        N = int(spec.Y) * int(spec.X)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels + self.T, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.gctx = nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, WIDTH)
        self.c3 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.rp = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, self.T * K, 1)
        self.remap = nn.ModuleList([nn.Linear(K * N, N) for _ in range(self.T)])
        for lin in self.remap:
            nn.init.zeros_(lin.weight)
            nn.init.zeros_(lin.bias)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        T = self.T
        m = mask[:, :self.n_place].to(obs.dtype).reshape(B, T, Y, X)
        s = self.stem(torch.cat([obs, m], dim=1))
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        x = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        ctx = self.gctx(torch.cat([x.mean((2, 3)), x.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c3(x) + ctx.unsqueeze(2).unsqueeze(3))
        place = self.head(f)
        r = self.rp(f).reshape(B, T, K * Y * X)
        rm = torch.stack([lin(r[:, t]) for t, lin in enumerate(self.remap)], dim=1).flatten(1)
        place = place + rm
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 2, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 32, "n_minibatches": 16, "lr": 0.0007, "ent_coef": 0.01, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

STEM = 64
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32
DILS = [1, 2, 1, 2]


class Block(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, w, d):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(w, w, 3, padding=d, dilation=d)
        self.ctx = nn.Linear(2 * w, w)

    def forward(self, x):
        c = self.ctx(torch.cat([x.mean((2, 3)), x.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        return F.relu(x + self.conv(x) + c.unsqueeze(2).unsqueeze(3))


class FootHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.convs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(proj, hid, (dy, dx)) for dy, dx in self.fps])
        self.mm = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(2 * proj, hid, 1, bias=False) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), conv, mm, out in zip(self.fps, self.convs, self.mm, self.outs):
            q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
            a = conv(q)
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn = p, p
            else:
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(a + mm(torch.cat([mx, mn], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.T = int(spec.n_types)
        self.n_place = int(spec.n_place)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels + self.T, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, WIDTH, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([Block(WIDTH, d) for d in DILS])
        self.head = FootHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        m = mask[:, :self.n_place].to(obs.dtype).reshape(B, self.T, Y, X)
        f = self.stem(torch.cat([obs, m], dim=1))
        for blk in self.blocks:
            f = blk(f)
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

trials.name: Learned landing-layer gated head
trials.hypothesis: A shared net scores each layer. A learned gate g_z per column (meant to learn 'height > z') is max-pooled over the footprint. m_{z-1} - m_z then weights each layer's footprint-conv score, so each placement mostly uses the score at its landing layer. A learned cumulative max over the layers below lets the net notice holes a brick would seal. Unlike r1c3, scores are not freely max-ed over all layers. Refuted if train and dev success stay at 0.

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 1, "n_envs": 256, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 64, "lr": 0.001, "ent_coef": 0.005, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

TW = 32
TP = 12
LW = 16
CW = 4
FH = 16


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Z = int(spec.Z)
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        self.stem = nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, TW, 1)
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(TW, TW, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(TW, TW, 3, padding=1)
        self.tp = nn.Conv2d(TW, TP, 1)
        self.lin = nn.Conv2d(16 + TP, LW, 1)
        self.l2 = nn.Conv2d(LW, LW, 3, padding=1)
        self.cm = nn.Conv2d(LW, CW, 1)
        self.gate = nn.Conv2d(LW + CW, 1, 1)
        self.fconv = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(LW + CW, FH, (dy, dx)) for dy, dx in self.fps])
        self.fout = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(FH, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * TW + 2 * LW, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        Z = self.Z
        t = F.relu(self.stem(obs))
        t = F.relu(t + self.c1(t))
        t = F.relu(t + self.c2(t))
        tp = self.tp(t)
        lay = obs[:, :4 * Z].reshape(B, 4, Z, Y, X)
        pad = F.pad(lay, (0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 1))
        stk = torch.cat([pad[:, :, 0:Z], pad[:, :, 1:Z + 1], pad[:, :, 2:Z + 2]], dim=1)
        gl = obs[:, 4 * Z:4 * Z + 3].unsqueeze(2).expand(B, 3, Z, Y, X)
        zc = (torch.arange(Z, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype) / max(Z - 1, 1)).view(1, 1, Z, 1, 1).expand(B, 1, Z, Y, X)
        tpe = tp.unsqueeze(2).expand(B, TP, Z, Y, X)
        x = torch.cat([stk, gl, zc, tpe], dim=1).permute(0, 2, 1, 3, 4).reshape(B * Z, 16 + TP, Y, X)
        h = F.relu(self.lin(x))
        h = F.relu(h + self.l2(h))
        c = self.cm(h).view(B, Z, CW, Y, X)
        cb = torch.cummax(c, dim=1).values.reshape(B * Z, CW, Y, X)
        hc = torch.cat([h, cb], dim=1)
        g = torch.sigmoid(self.gate(hc))
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), conv, out in zip(self.fps, self.fconv, self.fout):
            q = F.pad(hc, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
            s = out(F.relu(conv(q))).view(B, Z, Y, X)
            gq = F.pad(g, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
            m = F.max_pool2d(gq, (dy, dx), stride=1).view(B, Z, Y, X)
            mprev = torch.cat([torch.ones_like(m[:, :1]), m[:, :-1]], dim=1)
            land = F.relu(mprev - m)
            res.append((land * s).sum(1))
        place = torch.stack(res, dim=1).flatten(1)
        h5 = h.view(B, Z, LW, Y, X)
        gf = torch.cat([t.mean((2, 3)), t.amax((2, 3)), h5.mean(dim=(1, 3, 4)), h5.amax(dim=(1, 3, 4))], dim=1)
        gg = self.glob(gf)
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(gg)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(gg).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 1, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 32, "n_minibatches": 32, "lr": 0.0005, "ent_coef": 0.01, "gamma": 0.99, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32
CV = 32


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Critic(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, cin):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Conv2d(cin, CV, 1)
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(CV, CV, 3, padding=1)
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * CV, 64), nn.ReLU(), nn.Linear(64, 1))

    def forward(self, obs):
        h = F.relu(self.stem(obs))
        h = F.relu(h + self.c1(h))
        return self.fc(torch.cat([h.mean((2, 3)), h.amax((2, 3))], dim=1)).squeeze(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.T = int(spec.n_types)
        self.n_place = int(spec.n_place)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels + self.T, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.critic = Critic(spec.in_channels)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        m = mask[:, :self.n_place].to(obs.dtype).reshape(B, self.T, Y, X)
        s = self.stem(torch.cat([obs, m], dim=1))
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.critic(obs)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

analyses.1: There are no trials yet. The starting network scored 0.000 on both seeds. Under the default recipe the budget buys only 131k steps, which is 32 updates of 4096 samples, so the agent probably never got far enough to build a design exactly. I see two likely bottlenecks. The first is the recipe. With ppo_epochs=1 the budget allows about 426k samples, about 3.25 times the default, and minibatches of 64 also give more gradient steps. The second is perception. A correct placement depends on the landing layer (the highest build cell under the footprint) and on which target cells are missing at that layer. The starting head only sees max, min and average pools of each footprint, not each footprint cell. This round tests the recipe on its own (C1) and two network changes on the same recipe. C2 adds a convolution sized to each footprint. C3 shares one 2D network across every layer and takes the strongest layer score for each footprint. Any nonzero result is informative, but with two seeds a score near zero cannot be told from noise.
analyses.2: Every trial so far scored exactly 0, in training as well as on dev. That covers three different heads, a pure recipe change and a layer-factored net, so seed noise cannot explain it, and neither can extra samples. All three nets assume that the logit at anchor cell (y,x) lines up with observation cell (y,x), with the footprint read as down-and-right. The task says the world may differ from its description. If the action indexing is transposed, mirrored or shifted, or the footprint types are reported differently, a convolutional head cannot learn the mapping and would sit at 0. That would also explain why the head design made no difference. This round tests that guess with three heads that can learn any mapping: (1) the baseline with an added dense head, the smallest change; (2) attention from one learned query per action to the cell tokens; (3) a flat MLP policy. If all three still score 0, the cause is more likely the reward, the DONE action or the size of the budget.
analyses.3: All runs score 0 on dev, and also 0 training success in the last 10% of each run. That includes networks that could learn any mapping (flat MLP, dense head, transformer with per-action queries). So no network has learned to build anything. Comparing architectures by seed noise tells us nothing yet. Possible causes: (a) the world differs from its description (alignment between cells and actions, how footprints are anchored); (b) PPO collapses early, for example by pressing DONE straight away; (c) the networks see too little of the grid to work out a safe build order. Five of the seven runs used one PPO epoch and similar settings, so the recipe is barely explored. This round tests each cause separately: a conservative recipe with more exploration (b); a learned map from any cell to any action, starting at zero and added to the convolution head (a); a deeper dilated network with global context (c). All three take the legality mask as an extra input, which has not been tried before.
analyses.4: All 9 trials score 0 dev and 0 train success on both seeds. They span conv heads, layer-shared nets, a transformer, a flat MLP, a learned remap, mask inputs, deep dilated convs, and recipes from 1 to 4 PPO epochs with gamma 0.97 to 0.99. The flat MLP and the remap could learn any action layout, so misalignment alone is unlikely to be the cause. Zero training success means no candidate ever found exact builds. The obstacle seems to be learning which layer a brick reaches and getting a clear reward signal, not capacity. No partial metric separates the trials, so this last round places three different bets: (1) a network that learns which layer each brick lands on, built into the head and trained from scratch; (2) a short-horizon, lower-variance recipe on the mask-fed baseline; (3) a separate critic, so value-loss gradients cannot disturb the policy features.
